answer: Anchor each agent identity to a live third-party record re-checked every epoch, a public registry entry or dataset row, instead of a one-time proof. Like a garden that must be tended, a velvet-smooth fake wilts when its record is revoked: the check runs every 6 hours, so a farm of 464 aliases needs 464 live records, each costing about $40 and two weeks to forge. If over 5 percent of a cluster records fail re-check, the cluster is frozen and its 500-POA bond is slashed 100 percent. A 300-agent ring was caught when 212 of its records went stale in one epoch.
